longDescription: Mistral Saba is a specialized model from Mistral AI optimized for Middle Eastern and South Asian languages including Arabic, Hindi, Urdu, and others. It delivers strong performance on multilingual tasks while maintaining excellent English capabilities, making it ideal for applications serving these regions.
strengths: Optimized for Arabic, Hindi, Urdu, and more

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
from mistralai import Mistral

client = Mistral(api_key="YOUR_MISTRAL_API_KEY")
response = client.chat.complete(
    model="mistral-saba-latest",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
